analyze.title: SNS Spot Analyzer
analyze.subtitle: Curious about that spot? Paste the URL and we'll find it for you.
analyze.help_body: Paste a YouTube link and tap Analyze Spots. We'll list candidate places, so you can view them on the map or build a route.
analyze.invalid_url: This does not look like a supported YouTube URL.
analyze.unsupported_url: Paste a supported YouTube or Instagram URL.
analyze.instagram_pending_body: The app can now detect Instagram links, but live Instagram extraction is held until a no-cost or approved provider path is available.
analyze.loading_estimate: Backend analysis usually finishes in a few seconds. AI responses can take 10-20 seconds when the server is warming up.
analyze.loading_cold_start: If this takes longer, the analysis server may still be waking up.
analyze.loading_background_hint: Analysis keeps running even if you check out other tabs. We'll let you know when it's done.
analyze.error_timeout:
The analysis timed out.
Please try again in a moment.
analyze.error_generic:
Something went wrong during analysis.
Please try again in a moment.
analyze.error_reason_unrelated: If the URL isn't related to a travel spot, it can be hard to analyze.
analyze.error_reason_korea_only: The SNS analyzer currently only supports locations in Korea.
analyze.empty_body: Try a travel vlog or an MV location clip instead.
analyze.ai_disclaimer: This route was analyzed by AI, so it may not be fully accurate.
analyze.choose_action_hint: Choose what to do with this spot
analyze.popular_videos_subtitle: Official Korea Tourism Organization videos — tap to analyze instantly.
analyze.tutorial_gif_alt: GIF showing how to use the SNS analyzer: paste a URL, then pick a place from the results
analyze.tutorial_step1: Paste a YouTube link into the search box, then tap 'Analyze Spots'.
analyze.tutorial_step2: Feel free to browse around K-Vibe while it's analyzing — we'll let you know when it's done!
analyze.tutorial_step3: Once it's done, tap [Select] on any place to view it on the K-Vibe map or save it to your route.
analyze.tutorial_step4: Want everything at once? Tap 'View All on Map' or 'Add All to Route' at the bottom!
analyze.completion_toast_title:
Your analysis is ready!
Check out the results.
spotlight_captions: Breaking down every frame of the video...
Hunting for clues hidden in the background...
Could this be the cafe your bias once visited?
Tracing the real spot behind the camera angle...
Checking signs, interiors, and the view outside...
Comparing hundreds of screenshots with AI...
Narrowing down the most likely locations...
Getting ready to drop a pin on the map...
Almost there, just a little longer!

route.title: My Route
route.help_body: Drag stops to reorder, or use the up/down buttons. Tap a stop's time to set a specific date/time — everything after it recalculates from there.
route.helper: Drag stops to reorder. Tap a stop's time to set it manually.
route.empty_desc: Add spots from the map, SNS analysis, or persona builder to start your route.
empty_guide_map_steps: Click any place you'd like to add to your route.
Tap 'Add to Route' to save it to your route!
empty_guide_analyze_steps: Paste a YouTube link and tap 'Analyze Spots'.
Once it's done, tap [Add All to Route] to save every spot at once!
empty_guide_persona_steps: Pick your favorite artist or theme to generate a one-day route.
Like what you see? Tap 'Add to Route' to save it!
route.location_card_body: Check your current distance to {{name}} when you're ready to move.

route.location_unsupported: Location is not available in this browser.
route.location_check_error: Current location could not be checked. Try again later.
route.shared_route_invalid: Shared route could not be opened. Showing your saved route instead.
route.clear_route_confirm: This removes every stop in your current route. This can't be undone.
